people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Sinai
people.line: Mountain where Moses received the Ten Commandments

translations.web: The mountains quaked Yahweh’s presence, even Sinai at the presence of Yahweh, the God of Israel.
translations.bsb: The mountains quaked before the LORD, the One of Sinai, before the LORD, the God of Israel.
translations.kjv: The mountains melted from before the LORD, even that Sinai from before the LORD God of Israel.
translations.asv: The mountains quaked at the presence of Jehovah, Even yon Sinai at the presence of Jehovah, the God of Israel.
